name: Post
desc: The key: start under the rim. Up the left lane line is the glass (box-outs, boards), up the right the rim protection. They meet at the free-throw line, and Block Party sits at the top of the circle.

nodes.name: Get Low
nodes.desc: Wider box-out angle: players behind you get pushed further away from the ball.

nodes.name: Gimme That!
nodes.desc: Your blocks are snatch blocks: you pluck the ball out of the air and it's your ball.

nodes.name: Verticality
nodes.desc: Your contests on shots near the rim x1.2.

nodes.name: Anchor
nodes.desc: +8 Post D, +8 Block. Block chance x1.35.

nodes.name: Finger Wag
nodes.desc: Not in here. Your blocks give you x2 rhythm and take x2 rhythm from the shooter.

nodes.name: Foresight
nodes.desc: A shadow on the floor shows where a missed shot or a loose ball is going to come down.

nodes.name: Block Party
nodes.desc: GOAT skill. A dunk at the rim with you in front of him (inside his cone) is blocked every time, as long as you're bigger: your height plus a quarter of your strength beats his.
